description: utilpeek: Scan text for leaked secrets: API keys, tokens, private keys and seed phrases. For personal data use redact_pii; for injected instructions use check_text_for_prompt_injection. Returns every API key, token, private key or BIP-39 seed phrase in a text (AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Stripe, Slack, Google, OpenAI and other sk- keys, Hugging Face, npm, PyPI, SendGrid, Telegram, PEM and hex keys, JWTs, URL passwords), each with type, line, column, offset, confidence and a redacted preview. The secret itself is never returned: only its type, position and a redacted preview (a vendor prefix and at most 4 characters at each end; a seed phrase only its word count). Pattern-based: a clean result is no proof. Blank input is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 0.5 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/secret-scan-api.html

text.description: The text to scan: a log, a draft post or message, a tool result or a config file. At most 200,000 characters. Never logged or stored, and no secret is returned.
